raw:
Oscar Piastri's only team in the race reports and standings I retrieved is McLaren (2023–2025), so his teammate there was Lando Norris. The results show Piastri and Norris both racing for McLaren in 2023, 2024 and 2025, and the standings show Norris never finished higher than 2nd (2024) and never won the drivers' title. Piastri's own 2024 finish (4th) is also consistent with that.

Other drivers who won titles in 2000–2025 (Verstappen, Hamilton, Alonso, Räikkönen, Button and others) were never his teammates in the data I found. Daniel Ricciardo was at McLaren in 2021–2022, but Piastri was not racing in F1 then, so Ricciardo was not his teammate.

I did not run a dedicated search for Piastri's pre-2023 F1 history, so the answer rests on the McLaren-only picture in these results.

ANSWER: none
